in_sanskrit.name: शुभंशु
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: शुभ (shubh) means auspicious, blessed, prosperous. शु (shu) is a prefix meaning good, auspicious. अन् (anshu) is a suffix meaning desire, wish. So, Shubhanshu means one who desires good, prosperous things.

in_hindi.name: शुभंशु
in_hindi.meaning: शुभ (shubh) means आशा पूर्ण होना (aasha poorna hona) which means to be full of hope, to be blessed, to be prosperous. अन् (anshu) is a suffix meaning desire, wish. So, Shubhanshu means one who desires to be full of hope, to be blessed, to be prosperous.

in_tamil.name: ஶுப்பான்ஷு
in_tamil.meaning: ஶுப் (shubb) means auspicious, blessed. அன் (anshu) is a suffix meaning desire, wish. So, Shubhanshu means one who desires auspicious, blessed things.

in_telugu.name: శుభంశు
in_telugu.meaning: శుభ (shubh) means ఆశా పూర్ణ (aasha poorna) which means to be full of hope, to be blessed, to be prosperous. అన్ (anshu) is a suffix meaning desire, wish. So, Shubhanshu means one who desires to be full of hope, to be blessed, to be prosperous.

in_marathi.name: Shubhanshu
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Auspicious, Fortunate, Blessed
in_marathi.long_meaning: Shubhanshu हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Shubhanshu is a Sanskrit name derived from the Sanskrit word 'shubha', meaning 'auspicious' or 'fortune'. It is a name that signifies good fortune, prosperity, and blessings. The name is believed to bring happiness and success to the bearer.
